description: Data and analysis code for "When is a transferred surrogate safe to bypass power flow? Feeder-specific qualification of conformal voltage-security screening is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kamphol Promjiraprawat (Department of Computer Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Ramkhamhaeng University, Bangkapi, Bangkok 10240, ). This record provides the machine-readable evidence, publication-asset sources, and analysis code supporting the manuscript “When is a transferred surrogate safe to bypass power flow? Feeder-specific qualification of conformal voltage-security screening.” The package supports transparent verification and reproduction of the principal figures, tables, and reported summary analyses. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
